connected.paragraph1: Your node is connected to the IPFS network. It can fetch and serve content by CID.

notConnected.paragraph2: <0>Is your IPFS daemon running? Try starting or restarting Kubo from your terminal:</0>
notConnected.paragraph3: <0>Is your Kubo RPC API configured to allow <1>cross-origin (CORS) requests</1>? If not, run these commands and then start your daemon from the terminal:</0>
notConnected.paragraph4: <0>Is your Kubo RPC API on a port other than 5001? If your node is configured with a <1>custom API address</1>, enter it here.</0>

aboutIpfs.paragraph1: <0><0>A content-addressed protocol</0>: data is named by its hash, so a CID identifies the same bytes on every node</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph2: <0><0>A peer-to-peer network</0> where nodes exchange blocks directly, with no central server to take down or control</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph3: <0><0>HTTP access</0>: browsers read IPFS content through a gateway, or directly with the <2>IPFS Companion</2> extension</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph4: <0><0>Delivery by hash</0>: add a file to your node and any peer can fetch it by CID. Identical content is stored once and peers share the bandwidth</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph5: <0><0>A toolset for developers</0> building <2>distributed apps and services</2>, with an open-source community behind it</0>

welcomeInfo.paragraph1: <0><0>Check your node status</0>: connected peers, storage use and bandwidth</0>
welcomeInfo.paragraph2: <0><0>View and manage files</0> in your repo: import by drag and drop, pin, share and download</0>
welcomeInfo.paragraph3: <0><0>Explore IPLD</0> with sample datasets, the data model IPFS builds on</0>
welcomeInfo.paragraph4: <0><0>See connected peers</0> on a world map, placed by IP address</0>
welcomeInfo.paragraph5: <0><0>Review or edit your node settings</0> without the command line</0>
welcomeInfo.paragraph6: <0><0>Read this app's source code</0>, <2>report a bug</2> or contribute.</0>

step1.title: Welcome page
step1.paragraph1: This page lets you know if you're connected to IPFS, and offers ideas for things you can do in this app.
step1.paragraph2: If you aren't connected to the Kubo RPC API, this page also appears in place of some other pages, with hints for how to get connected.
step1.paragraph3: You can visit this page from anywhere in the app by clicking the logo at the top of the navigation bar.
